Motivated QA Automation Engineer focused on building reliable test automation and API testing frameworks. Notice period: 60 days.

QA Automation Engineer, Tata Consultancy Services — Mar 2026 - Present
Implemented automated UI test suites using Selenium to validate critical workflows for an enterprise web application, reducing manual regression time by enabling nightly runs and catching release-blocking defects earlier. Developed reusable Selenium page-object components and integrated them into CI pipelines to execute cross-browser checks. Created and executed Postman collections and automated API smoke tests to validate backend endpoints, parameterized test data, and documented common API failure modes. Worked on Linux-based test agents for scheduled automation runs and coordinated with developers on defect triage.

Skills: Selenium, Test Automation, Postman, Linux

Education: MCA, Symbiosis
